selection: average all three seeds; early stop on seven-horizon validation MAE; report every primary and stress scenario
scope: same force-aware driven model, with initial angle anchored to current measurement plus at most half a nominal encoder bin; no true-state confidence guarantee
context: raw 125-dimensional context with forced-observer coefficients; phase context is prepared by shared runner but is not consumed by this variant
quantization: TRAIN records 3/6 match nominal 2pi/4096 grid; record 5 has a constant grid offset with maximum remaining mismatch 3.87e-5 bins; this does not prove physical zero calibration or a probabilistic noise model
